title: "My Lord, I Have Wronged Myself" — the Four Words Said by a Pagan Queen and a Future Prophet
excerpt: The exact confession rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi ("My Lord, I have wronged myself") is spoken by exactly two people in the Quran: the Queen of Sheba at the moment she leaves sun-worship (27:44) and Musa right after he kills a man (28:16). Two utterly different people, two different turning points, one identical sentence of turning back.
seo_title: Who Says "I Have Wronged Myself" in the Quran? 27:44 and 28:16
seo_description: The four-word confession rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi is said by exactly two speakers in the Quran: the Queen of Sheba (27:44) and Musa (28:16). A corpus-verified reading, distinct from the plural "we have wronged ourselves" of Adam and his wife at 7:23.
